name: The David Kempinski
positioning: Kosher beachfront hotel (officially The David Kempinski Tel Aviv) on the Tel Aviv promenade, opened in April 2022
best_for: Travelers who want a beachfront base on the Tel Aviv promenade
Guests who want a kosher-certified hotel

facts.text: The hotel is in the centre of Tel Aviv's promenade, facing the beach, between the Marina and Jaffa.
The hotel is 35 minutes (14 km) from Ben Gurion Airport.
The hotel is on HaYarkon Street with direct access to the boardwalk and the sea.
Rothschild Boulevard, Carmel Market, Dizengoff Square, the Bauhaus Museum, Neve Tzedek and Old Jaffa are a short walk or quick ride from the hotel.
The hotel has kosher dining experiences, including a cocktail lounge and cigar bar.
The hotel has a swimming pool, a spa and an events space for corporate and social gatherings.
The hotel is fully Kosher certified.
Breakfast is served in the restaurant or outdoors on the deck with a beach view.
Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards 2025 and 2026.

highlights.text: The Horizon Lounge is a private lounge upstairs for guests to work, relax or eat while enjoying views of the Mediterranean coast.
The David Penthouse is a three-floor, two-bedroom penthouse with a private gym and infinity pool.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows instead of balconies; the windows open with a stationary glass panel.
Even the most affordable rooms have at least a partial ocean view.

considerations.text: Rooms have no balconies; floor-to-ceiling windows open only with a stationary glass panel.
Underground parking is for hotel guests, subject to availability with no advance reservations, and valet parking is not offered.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
